when: A summary of findings or numbers: a month in review, a document's key points, a check. Up to four figures, the short of it in words, where things went as bars, one thing worth doing.
title: Your October in numbers
lede: What you spent, where it went, and one thing worth changing.

blocks.text: **The short of it.** Spending came down, mostly from fewer taxis after the bus pass. Eating out held steady.

blocks.label: Worth changing:
blocks.text: two streaming plans overlap; dropping one saves €9 a month.
